shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, ledger-aware island logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- Logistics doctrine: storage priority wins; consumers fetch back per need; demand hauls residual-clamped + ledger-aware; ALL carried-cargo continuations target the LANDED thing (merge-safe).
- Needs-bridge doctrine: postfix the vanilla giver, keep any real local result, re-run the giver's own guard chain, probe linked levels virtually with the SAME vanilla finder, one-hop stairs job, giver re-fires on arrival; per-pawn fail cooldowns.

## REMOVED FEATURES (postmortems preserved)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — postmortem pass 16. **MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed per user; revisit dossier in pass 22 schematic + lore (biomes): water facts, three-signal detection, per-FACE hydrology, ExecuteLift machinery; UNSOLVED: per-stretch single-exit-face lips + braided-terrain seal.

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · bug-wave fixes "mostly fixed" (USER): mech charge crash gone, bill supply + mech RMB working.

## RECENT FIX HISTORY (passes 23-25)
Pass 23: Invoke(null) fix + demand fan-cap + forbidden-aware availability + mech RMB. Pass 24: ferry discipline (ledger/clamps/onward hop). Pass 25: merge-kill fix + bill-product continuation.

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (pass 26 scan; P0 p27; P1 p28; P2 p29; P3 p30)

## Audit baseline (do not rebuild)
Work migration core (idle full-scan + better-work probes + emergency scan + robot variant) · full ferry stack · needs bridges · areas · counters/wealth/home/bonds/colonist bar/trade/caravans/power/pipes/weather · threats · mech suite · animal flows.

## P0 — UI TRUTH ✅ (p27)
Skill-warning dialog column-scoped · restriction dropdown CLEAN · meal/defense/joy alerts column-union · research bench + fire visibility CLEAN. Deferred: lambda-buried RecipeRequiresMechanitor edge.

## P1 — EMERGENCY RESPONSIVENESS ✅ (p28)
IsPatient += surgery bills · Fire.SpawnSetup version bump · BillStack.AddBill bump + demand invalidate. AUDITED ALREADY-BUILT: emergency wiring, feed pulls, flick re-arm.

## P2 — NEEDS COMPLETENESS ✅ (p29, NeedsPatches.cs)
Scheduled drugs bridge · patient self-bedding (vanilla guard chain mirrored; crawlers excluded) · deathrest (keys off ground-sleep fallback; assigned-casket column routing; Biotech-gated).

## P3 — DLC DOERS ✅ BUILT/AUDITED (pass 30)
13. **Anomaly entity containment** ✅ BUILT (EntityAcrossLevels.cs + defs + driver support): (a) capture-gizmo availability postfix (HoldingPlatformAvailableOnCurrentMap → column-wide; targeter itself already accepts cross-map clicks and the assignment survives CompTick), (b) WorkGiver_ABTakeEntityAcrossLevels (Hauling, priority 290 — below vanilla's 300 so same-map wins; mirrors vanilla eligibility incl. ThreatDisabled; strict stairs routing one hop at a time), (c) JobDriver_ABTakePawnAcrossLevels extended (entity FailOn = threat-disabled, intent Auto = land at exit, no bed continuation), (d) pending order re-arms targetHolder after each hop (PostSpawnSetup wipes cross-map holders on intermediate-level respawn); vanilla giver finishes the final same-map leg. DEFERRED: platform-to-platform transfer of already-held entities stays same-map.
14. **Children's schooling** ✅ BUILT (LearningAcrossLevels.cs): JobGiver_Learn postfix, house bridge shape — lessontaking desire active + worker's OWN CanDo probed virtually (teacher/desk/spot on the school level) → hop; other learning desires stay local by design.
15. **Throne/Reign** ✅ AUDITED COVERED — Reign jobs are made ONLY in MeditationUtility.GetMeditationJob (JobDriver_Reign : JobDriver_Meditate); our existing meditation bridge routes toward assigned thrones cross-level. Residual: joy-path meditation (JoyGiver) unbridged — minor, verify in session.
16. **Mech repair/gestation** ✅ AUDITED COVERED — MechRepair plausibility bit (damaged-mech detector) already in LevelWorkSummary.Build; Building_MechGestator : Building_WorkTableAutonomous : Building_WorkTable → bills detector covers gestation bills; migration runs the full vanilla scan. Verify in session.
17. **Anima linking** — DEFERRED to optional (rare, player-initiated; linking-ritual candidate list is map-scoped; workaround: walk the psycaster to the tree's level first).

## P4 — VERIFY-ONLY (test session, build only if red)
18. ## OPEN QUESTIONS / OPTIONAL

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE

0b. P0 (skill-bill dialog, false alerts). 0c. P1 (fire response, busy surgeon, instant bill ferries).

1. Below-level lighting. 2. Animal flow + direct-to-blueprint. 3. BAM/Batch B/C. 4. Perf smoke, CE-absent, translation audit, soak, publishing. 5. P4 sweep (+item 28).

## FEATURE LEDGER

## Status
2026-07-25 (30th pass): **P3 built green — entity containment across levels (gizmo + giver + holder re-arm), children's schooling bridge; reign and mech repair/gestation audited as already covered.** ENTIRE SCAFFOLD P0-P3 NOW BUILT; P4 is verify-only.
